drivingQuestion: On what principle do the three tannaim of the mishna differ about overflows?
outcomeNote: question only; the answer opens the next unit (menachot.sugya342)

segments.he: מִדֹּת הַלַּח בֵּירוּצֵיהֶן קֹדֶשׁ, בְּמַאי קָא מִיפַּלְגִי?
segments.en: § The mishna discusses the status of overflows: The first tanna states simply that with regard to «measuring vessels for liquids, their overflows are sacred,» but with regard to measuring vessels for dry substances, their overflows are non-sacred. Rabbi Akiva explains that this distinction is a function of whether the measuring vessel is itself sacred. Rabbi Yosei explains it is function of whether the overflow had initially been inside the vessel. The Gemara asks: «With regard to what» matter «do» these three tanna’im «disagree?»
